records.title: Canonical Atom v2 representation and journal surface
records.statement: The TypeScript runtime contains decoders for a canonical schema, commit command, and authorization grants, plus a durable-runtime service and state-journal decoding path.
records.claim_boundary: Decoder and runtime-service presence is not evidence that a canonical cognitive loop, admission authority, or learning process ran.

records.title: RDF 1.1 N-Quads read-only projection
records.statement: The canonical Atom v2 RDF compiler emits a deterministic blank-node-free RDF 1.1 N-Quads profile and labels it as non-RDFC with a no-canonical-state nonclaim.
records.source_locator: A deterministic, blank-node-free RDF 1.1 N-Quads profile; not an RDFC claim.
records.claim_boundary: This is an exchange projection only; it does not establish RDFC, canonical HSWM state, cognition, learning, permission, or efficacy.

records.title: Deterministic hypergraph projection without writeback
records.statement: The hypergraph projection profile forbids writeback and limits its claim ceiling to bounded metadata parity rather than HSWM realization or learning.
records.claim_boundary: Projection compilation and self-consistency verification do not authorize a canonical-state write or demonstrate executable graph semantics.

records.title: Bounded durable RDF recovery projection
records.statement: The durable RDF projection records a local POSIX one-recovery-observation prefix attestation and enumerates nonclaims including RDFC, SHACL, PROV, causal credit, and LLM efficacy.
records.claim_boundary: The artifact does not attest a global complete tail, anti-rollback, distributed storage, external notary, canonical state, cognition, learning, permission, or efficacy.

records.title: Transition evidence remains non-causal and non-admitting
records.statement: The transition-evidence schema labels represented outcomes as not causal credit and labels represented admission as not admitted, permitted, or learning.
records.claim_boundary: A represented decision, receipt, effect, or outcome must remain an attributed evidence record rather than a permit, external effect, or causal-learning conclusion.

records.title: Repository ontology projection boundary
records.statement: The checked-in core ontology declares its repository-ontology projection unable to commit back to core state and rejects any remote-publication policy other than NOT_AUTHORIZED.
records.claim_boundary: A repository or KG projection is not an HSWM state write path and does not grant remote publication authority.

records.title: Research-fabric controller is operational observation only
records.statement: The research-fabric domain defines Phoenix and Temporal process control as bounded infrastructure observation and expressly excludes cognition, canonical admission, causal credit, continuous-learning evidence, and efficacy.
records.source_locator: bounded infrastructure observation; not HSWM cognition, canonical admission, causal credit, continuous-learning evidence, or efficacy
records.claim_boundary: Committed process-control code is not a live service observation or a proof of deployment readiness, HSWM cognition, or learning.

records.title: S2S production path remains gate-closed historical work
records.statement: The recorded S2S stage-read/replay checkpoint states that no closed production prepare/assert-upload program and no successful live production Layer issuance existed at that checkpoint.
